cypher: MATCH (d:DLDeveloper)-[:DL_AUTHORED_COMMIT]->(c:DLCommit)-[:DL_MODIFIED_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE d.dataset=$dataset AND d.repo=$repo AND f.path STARTS WITH $prefix WITH d,collect(DISTINCT c.id)+collect(DISTINCT f.id) AS evidence RETURN coalesce(d.email,d.login,d.name) AS entity,coalesce(d.email,d.login,d.name) AS fact,[d.id]+evidence AS evidence_ids ORDER BY entity LIMIT 10
